OUR JOURNEY

THE ROAD TO ĀROHANA

"I built Ārohana after spending years inside businesses — learning what makes them work, what makes them struggle, and what people are only after they become responsible for the whole thing."

01

It Started With Hospitality

Hospitality teaches you what no business textbook can: obsessive attention to customer touchpoints, micro-moments of delight, and brutal operational precision where margins matter every single shift.

02

There Were A Few Unexpected Detours

Venturing across real estate, manufacturing, digital products, and independent ventures revealed a common thread: great products often fail not because of product flaws, but because brand strategy and commercial reality never talk to each other.

03

And Then, The Work Got Interesting

We eliminated the agency fluff. No vanity pitch decks. No disconnected creative departments. We began structuring hybrid teams that sit right at the intersection of brand narrative, physical experience, and bottom-line revenue.

04

Where Ārohana Stands Today

Today, Ārohana partners with founders and enterprises across India and beyond, crafting timeless brands, scaling hospitality ventures, and documenting transformative stories.

TOURIN BY ĀROHANA

TRAVEL BEYOND THE ITINERARY

The Ladakh people experience and the Ladakh most itineraries sell are not always the same. Tourin is our experiential curation unit — exploring raw frontiers, remote Himalayan communities, and mindful expeditions.

Raw Expedition Routes

Passes beyond the tourist trails. Curated routes with vetted safety, support vehicles, and unmatched vistas.

Local Cultural Immersion

Stay with local families, break bread in remote monasteries, and support indigenous Himalayan arts.

Bespoke Group & Solo Outings

From Enfield motorcycle rallies to quiet mountain retreats, designed for discerning travelers.
